title: Left 2D Thrust-Vectoring Nozzle
summary: Rectangular two-dimensional convergent-divergent exhaust nozzle with ±20° pitch thrust vectoring and low-observable infrared/radar shaping.
role: Modulates exhaust exit area for dry/afterburner flow, vectors thrust ±20° in pitch, and flattens the exhaust plume to reduce infrared signature.
